Hi all —

Quick tech/ops note on the billing path choices: 
- AWS Private Offer: Pros — fastest to reserve dedicated capacity in your preferred region and keeps billing consolidated within your AWS relationship. Cons — procurement sometimes needs a separate contract review cycle for AWS Marketplace Private Offers (we can provide the AWS PO template and legal language).
- Redwood invoice (net-30): Pros — simpler from our legal side; Finance can issue a PO against Redwood. Cons — may require internal approval at Acme for external vendor invoices and could delay capacity reservation if AWS commit is required first.

If you need immediate throughput for an evaluation window, we can provision short-term hosted capacity while the private-offer flows through procurement. That avoids blocking the eval while PO clears. If you can confirm Acme's finance contact, Grace will run the billing onboarding checklist and prepare the invoice schedule.

Karthik
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
